Sacramento, CA · 29 units

The Golden Lofts

Experience urban living in the heart of Downtown Sacramento. The Golden Lofts is a restored 1919 landmark offering distinctive efficiency studios just steps from the J Street corridor, State Capitol, dining, nightlife, entertainment, and some of the city’s most recognizable destinations.

Visit Community Website

Historic Character. Downtown Energy.

The Golden Lofts blends the character of a historic Sacramento building with convenient modern living. Its central location makes it easy to experience the best of Downtown and Midtown, whether you’re heading to work, meeting friends for dinner, or catching an event at Golden 1 Center.

Community Amenities

  • Historic building
  • Serene courtyard
  • Bike racks
  • Laundry facilities
  • High-speed internet
  • On-site management
  • Spanish-speaking staff
  • No-deposit option for qualified residents

Apartment Features

  • Furnished residences
  • Hardwood floors
  • Air conditioning
  • Efficient appliances
  • Refrigerator
  • Microwave

In the Heart of Sacramento

Live steps from the State Capitol and within easy reach of Golden 1 Center, local restaurants, cafés, boutiques, parks, entertainment, and Sacramento’s arts and nightlife scene. It’s a location designed for residents who want the city right outside their front door.
